testing_framework.hypothesis_type: One-sided paired non-inferiority test for corporate distress recall

practical_tier.description: 10.0 percentage points maximum sensitivity loss under acute workload rationing

testing_framework.unaltered_margin_commitment: Evaluated strictly at delta=0.05 and delta=0.10 without post-hoc modification.

discrepancy_analysis.root_cause_of_discrepancy: The Phase 6.3/6.4 reports adopted the Lan-DeMets (1983) spending formula 2 - 2*Phi(Z_{0.025}/sqrt(t)). Although calibrated to spend 0.0500 at t=1, its mathematical functional form incorporates a two-sided reflection principle (factor of 2) and uses the two-sided critical value Z_{0.025} = 1.95996, despite the test being strictly one-sided. A purely one-sided spending formulation does not feature the reflection factor of 2.

design_1_lan_demets_sfldof_z0025.name: Lan-DeMets sfLDOF with Z_{0.025} (Two-sided constant applied to one-sided)

design_2_pure_one_sided_obf.name: Pure One-Sided O'Brien-Fleming Spending Function
design_2_pure_one_sided_obf.characterization: UNREFLECTED_ONE_SIDED (Spends 0.002193 at Look 1; 3.19x faster early spending than Design 1)

protocol_governance_verdict.governance_rule: Because a structural discrepancy exists between the two-sided reflection constant Z_{0.025} and pure one-sided spending formulations, and consensus between biostatistical and model validation authorities has not been finalized, the confirmatory sequential protocol is marked UNVERIFIED. It is strictly PROHIBITED from being used to authorize candidate promotion. Passive shadow observation continues without reliance on the disputed boundaries.
